title: Central Texas Planning & Water Outlook
summary:
*   **Future Growth:** City leaders received an update on regional planning initiatives across Central Texas.
*   **Water Bills & Services:** A detailed review was presented on the financial health and operations of the city's water and wastewater utility.
*   **Informational Session:** The meeting served as a work session for presentations and discussions, with no final policy decisions made.
